_how_to: Copy this file into your army folder (e.g. images/monster-army/) and rename it to bases.json.
_names: Use the unit or model name exactly as in your New Recruit list. Upper/lower case, 'The' and plural -s don't matter: 'Little Monsters', 'Little Monster' and 'little monster' are the same.
_units_vs_models: Model names win over unit names. A unit with different models (e.g. '4x Flying Monster' and '1x Flying Monster Prime') can get one entry per model name.
_sizes: Size in mm. Round bases: a number, e.g. 32. Oval bases: "long x short" in quotes, e.g. "105x70".
_missing: Units without an entry get a size estimated from their image; the console lists them.
_lines_starting_with_underscore: are comments and are ignored. Replace the examples below with your own units.
